project_type: Next.js 16 App Router application with Prisma 7 ORM and OpenAI integration
build_system: npm with Next.js build, Prisma generate for schema changes. Quirks: Prisma 7 requires adapter in constructor, createMany unreliable.
test_framework: vitest with tests at src/lib/__tests__/*.test.ts pattern. Mocks openai and llm-guard modules.
build_command: export PATH=/opt/toolchains/.nvm/versions/node/v22.23.2/bin:$PATH && cd /projects/sandbox/career-toolkit && npx prisma generate && npm run lint && npm run build
verification_instructions: 1. Run npx prisma generate after schema changes. 2. Run npm run lint. 3. Run npm run build. 4. Run npx vitest run.
snapshot_or_generated_files: src/generated/prisma/ is auto-generated by 'npx prisma generate' from prisma/schema.prisma. Never edit generated/ directly.
setup_instructions: export PATH=/opt/toolchains/.nvm/versions/node/v22.23.2/bin:$PATH && cd /projects/sandbox/career-toolkit && npm install && npx prisma generate
environment_constraints: Node v22.23.2 at /opt/toolchains/.nvm/versions/node/v22.23.2/bin. OPEN_INTERNET network mode. No .env file so DB/OpenAI calls will fail at runtime, but build and unit tests should pass with mocks. No OPENAI_API_KEY or POSTGRES_URL available.
contribution_requirements: API routes use try/catch with formatErrorResponse. Import alias @/ for src/. Prisma client from @/lib/db. LLM calls go through guardedLLMCall. Tests mock openai and llm-guard modules.
key_patterns: 1. Prompt templates: versioned constants in src/lib/prompts/ (see decomposition.ts pattern). 2. Services in src/lib/ with pure logic separated from API routes. 3. API routes at src/app/api/{resource}/route.ts using NextRequest/NextResponse. 4. Tests mock openai default export class and llm-guard module. 5. Error handling via ApiError class, formatErrorResponse, generateRequestId, validationError from @/lib/api-error.
directory_structure: src/app/api/ - API routes, src/lib/ - business logic, src/lib/__tests__/ - unit tests, src/lib/prompts/ - prompt templates, src/lib/decomposition/ - Phase 2 services, prisma/ - schema and migrations, src/generated/prisma/ - auto-generated client
